requirements:
# Multi-Pump Switching Control System - **Difficulty:** Medium (medium) ## Requirements In an industrial water supply system, there are 5 pumps, each of which can be controlled independently. The system needs to support both manual and automatic operating modes. Based on the value of the mode variable, switch to the corresponding operating mode. In manual mode, control the start and stop of the selected pump based on the value of pumpGroup[1..5].selection. In automatic mode, compare the priority of each pump, and automatically select the 3 pumps with higher priority for water supply according to the method of three in use and two on standby. ## Interface Definition | Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Input | `mode` | `BOOL` | FALSE: Manual mode
TRUE: Automatic mode | | Input | `start` | `BOOL` | Start button, used to start the manually selected or automatically selected pump | | Input | `stop` | `BOOL` | Stop button, used to stop all pumps | | Input/Output | `pumpGroup` | `ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump` | Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd. | **Data type `ST_Pump`** | Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `priority` | `INT` | Priority; larger values have higher priority. Read-only to the function block. | | `selection` | `BOOL` | Manual-selection state. Read-only to the function block. | | `RunComd` | `BOOL` | Run command written by the function block; TRUE runs and FALSE stops. |
scenario: In an industrial water supply system, there are 5 pumps, each of which can be controlled independently. The system needs to support both manual and automatic operating modes.

interface.name: start
interface.description: Start button, used to start the manually selected or automatically selected pump

interface.name: stop
interface.description: Stop button, used to stop all pumps

interface.name: pumpGroup
interface.description: Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd.

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: Stop wins over a simultaneous start.
Read-only priority and selection fields must be unchanged.
assumptions: stop has priority over start and clears all five commands.
A start command selects the running set from current mode/configuration; commands are retained while neither button is TRUE. There is no automatic selection change until another start.
Equal priorities are resolved by lower array index first. Selection is ignored in automatic mode.
The caller initializes every RunComd FALSE before creating the first operational scan. Only RunComd may be written.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

V2 confirms the existing evaluation policy: start is level-sensitive and reselects each TRUE invocation; without start, mode/selection/priority changes do not reselect. Automatic top-three applies to selection events, not unconditionally to every automatic invocation.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

ltl.explanation: Manual start uses exactly the selected pumps.

ltl.formula: G((!stop & start & mode) -> (((runs[1] <-> TopThree1)) & ((runs[2] <-> TopThree2)) & ((runs[3] <-> TopThree3)) & ((runs[4] <-> TopThree4)) & ((runs[5] <-> TopThree5))))
ltl.explanation: Automatic start runs exactly the highest-priority three.
The FB may not modify priorities or selections.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.top3: Deprecated alias for automatic top-3 selection; active P3 uses expanded TopThree1..TopThree5.
atomic_propositions.runPrev[i]: The pre-scan RunComd value of pump i.
atomic_propositions.readOnlyPreserved: All five priority and selection values equal their sampled values.
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or output.
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehaviorV2:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB007(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehaviorV2[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
数组序号j=0..4，对应PLC下标j+1。stop时全部RunComd=FALSE；否则start时手动取selection，自动取按(-priority,j)升序排列的前三项；无start保持采样RunComd。priority和selection实际扫描后必须精确等于采样值。
atomic_propositions.TopThree1: (1-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.TopThree2: (2-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.TopThree3: (3-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.TopThree4: (4-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.TopThree5: (5-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.pumpGroup: O[k].pumpGroup: independently observed post-scan candidate value (ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump); never defined as expected output. I[k].pumpGroup denotes separately captured caller value before invocation.

tests.purpose: Manual latching, read-only fields and simultaneous stop/start
Automatic top-three selection and deterministic ties
Ties, changed priorities without start, reselection and simultaneous stop/start.

tests.description: No-start mode/selection changes preserve commands, tie breaking [100,100,5,5,5], stop&start clear, and INT priority extremes.

specification_contract.history_binding: I, O and Sref namespaces, initialization and updates are defined in normalized_specification.observation, history_bindings and reference_state_initial. Candidate output never drives Sref.
specification_contract.evaluation_scope: Versioned executable scan predicate plus LTL over interpreted predicates. No native checker encoding or completed formal proof is claimed.
specification_contract.transition_binding: Use normalized_specification.transition and exact pinned source snapshots.

normalized_specification.language: LTL over typed scan predicates; finite conjunction is a binding-time macro, not native NuSMV syntax.

transition.reference_binding: Persistent plc_agent.scan_contract.ScanContract('PUB007'); constructed once per independent case, current state is Sref[k].
transition.state_update: Exactly once per scan; mutations of sampled IN_OUT copies are reference effects, not observations.
transition.hash_encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; all line endings normalized to LF before SHA256

comparison.integer_boolean: exact type and value; no tolerance
comparison.float: finite; abs error<=1e-5; dictionary/list shape and non-float values exact
comparison.PUB008: only successfully converted channels[j].outputValue: abs<=1e-5 OR rel<=2e-6; all preserved/config fields exact
comparison.PUB017: Successful deletion constrains recipeID=0; other fields of that deleted slot are unconstrained for the deletion scan. Subsequent no-write scans preserve the sampled actual representation. This observer history is separate from the logical reference database.
comparison.TIME_LTIME: exact integer nanoseconds after IEC literal parsing
comparison.implementation: plc_agent.normalized_spec.NormalizedScanMonitor.step with output_matches (pinned sources); observer histories never drive the independent logical reference

observation.I[k]: deep-copied inputs immediately before invocation k
observation.O[k]: actual outputs immediately after invocation k, supplied by independent execution backend
observation.Sref[k]: independent reference state BEFORE k; unrelated to similarly named candidate variables
observation.initial: fresh instance BEFORE invocation 0; never substituted by O[0]
observation.X: next scan-sequence position; argument must be Boolean, not a numeric term
observation.time: dt_ms is observed elapsed time; public timers use physical time, SELF Tick/count timers use logical scans

auxiliary_state_bindings.Spre: Sref[k], before the invocation; initialized by reference_state_initial
auxiliary_state_bindings.Spost: Sref[k+1], after exactly one pinned transition on I[k]
auxiliary_state_bindings.first: k=0 (first invocation); distinct from the pre-invocation initial observation
auxiliary_state_bindings.pre-output: actual O[k-1] for OUTPUT (explicit history initial where declared); I[k] for caller-owned IN_OUT
auxiliary_state_bindings.previous-input: I[k-1] for k>=1; edge memory for BOOL requests initially FALSE and updated after EVERY invocation
auxiliary_state_bindings.reference_warning: Spre/Spost predicates are input-driven ghosts, not evidence that candidate internals match. Conclusions about the candidate must constrain actual O.

normalized_specification.reference_state_rule: Initial state is the serialized constructor above; all fields update solely through the pinned transition. Ghost phase/history/queue are names for this state, not observed candidate state.

primitives.bitwise: DWORD AND/NOT and popcount operate on unsigned 32-bit values; complement is masked by 0xFFFFFFFF.
primitives.time_literals: IEC TIME/LTIME literals are exact integer durations in nanoseconds.
primitives.observed_arrays: All IN_OUT inputs are snapshots before invocation; outputs are independently acquired after invocation. Physical bounds map by ordinal, never share another array lower bound.
primitives.boolean_next: X takes a Boolean formula. Numeric history transport is bit-expanded for DWORD; Boolean histories use equivalence.
primitives.time_progress: Timed eventuality clauses explicitly require G(F(TimeTick)); TimeTick denotes crossing a new integer-ms boundary. Finite observations cannot establish this premise.
